description:
The process of Vacations Request starts when any employee of the organization submits a vacation request.
Once the requirement is registered, the request is received by the immediate supervisor of the employee requesting the vacation.
The supervisor must approve or reject the request.
If the request is rejected, the application is returned to the applicant / employee who can review the rejection reasons.
If the request is approved a notification is generated to the Human Resources Representative, who must complete the respective management procedures.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacation Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_VacationRequest" name="Vacation request process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SupervisorReceivesRequest" name="Immediate supervisor receives request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SupervisorDecision" name="Approve or reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestDecision" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected_Return</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteProcedures" name="Complete management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRequest" name="Return request to applicant">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected_Return</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed" name="Rejection reasons reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_VacationRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Register" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_SupervisorReceivesRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_SupervisorReceivesRequest" targetRef="Task_SupervisorDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_SupervisorDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RequestDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved_Notify" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_GenerateNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected_Return" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_End" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReviewed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
